# `federal_register_agencies`

**Federal Register typed document agencies (Layer 1)**

Physical typed child table (`federal_register_agencies.parquet`) holding one row per publisher agency entry on a Federal Register document in zero-based source order, including `id`, `parent_id`, `raw_name`, `name`, `slug`, `url`, `json_url`, and `member_names`. Distinct from the legacy MCP SQL relationship views `federal_register_agencies_occurrences` and `federal_register_agencies_pairs` over `federal_register`, which expose only `(document_number, publication_date, source_ordinal, target_key)` without full agency attributes or URLs.

**Coverage.** Derived: one row per element of `agencies` on every document in `federal_register_documents` (from 1994-01-03 onward). *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** Preserves exact publisher order via zero-based `position` and does NOT deduplicate repeated canonical `id` or `slug` values when a document lists multiple distinct `<SUBAGY>`/`<AGENCY>` entries resolving to the same agency. Joins `federal_register_documents` on (`document_number`, `publication_date`) with native `DATE` equality; zero orphan rows are enforced on every build. `member_names` distinguishes absent agency JSON keys from explicit JSON `null`.

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_agencies.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Parent document's reversible dated source identity (`document_number@YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Parent Federal Register document number; joins `federal_register_documents` with `publication_date`. |
| `publication_date` | `DATE` | Parent document's native `DATE` publication date; joins `federal_register_documents` with `document_number`. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the retained API page blob containing the parent document. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Zero-based JSON Pointer (`/results/<doc>/agencies/<position>`) locating this agency object inside the retained blob. |
| `position` | `INTEGER` | Zero-based ordinal position (`INTEGER`) of this agency entry in the parent document's `agencies` array. |
| `member_names` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of JSON keys present on this raw agency object, distinguishing absent keys from explicit `null`. |
| `id` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` Federal Register canonical agency identifier; may repeat across entries on one document, or be NULL on unmapped raw entries. |
| `parent_id` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` Federal Register parent agency identifier; NULL for top-level agencies or when omitted. |
| `json_url` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register API JSON endpoint URL for this agency; omitted on legacy `federal_register` and preserved here. |
| `name` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical agency name stated by the Federal Register API. |
| `raw_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal agency/subagency heading string as printed on the Federal Register document. |
| `slug` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register URL slug for the canonical agency; may repeat across entries on one document. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register web page URL for this agency; omitted on legacy `federal_register` and preserved here. |
